name: Nezabyvayemye priklyucheniya
source:
The protagonist, Vladislav, is 25 years old. One day, he ended up in the Sovyonok pioneer camp. After the search for Shurik, Elektronik decided to celebrate it in a civilized manner, and what happened next, you will find out in the mod.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1804792720]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公弗拉迪斯拉夫今年25岁。有一天，他来到了苏维约诺克先锋营。在寻找Shurik后，Elektronik决定以文明的方式庆祝它，接下来发生了什么，你将在mod中找到答案。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1804792720]Steam[/url]]
